name: v3.1.1 - RPC Fallback + Auto Proxy
body:
## Fixes

- **RPC Timeout Fallback**: api-client-adapter now uses createRobustProvider with 9 BSC RPC fallback nodes. No more fatal crashes when a single RPC times out.
- **Auto Proxy Detection**: Desktop launcher auto-detects local proxies (Clash/Surge/V2Ray etc.) on common ports (7890/7891/1087/1080/8080/6152/8001) and injects HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY into the child process. Fixes the issue where Node.js does not inherit macOS system proxy settings.

## Install

Download PredictFun Market Maker-3.1.0-arm64.dmg for macOS (Apple Silicon).

name: v2.2.9 - 安全修复版
body:
修复内容：
- 私钥安全：不再将 .env 配置文件打包进 release，避免泄露 API_KEY 和 PRIVATE_KEY
- 首次启动自动在 userData 目录创建空 .env 模板，用户可在APP内编辑配置
- 修复 Windows 打包后找不到 .env 的路径问题
- 使用 extraResources 将 runtime-dist 放到 asar 外，确保原生 Node 可读取

name: v2.2.6 - Security Fixes
body:
## Security Fixes

### P0 - Critical
- toWei throws on invalid values
- buildLimitOrderPayload validates params
- cancelOrder detects already-filled/cancelled

### P1 - High Risk  
- stop() awaits cancellations
- SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful shutdown
- Date.now() + random suffix
- WS try-catch protection
- Wallet init validation
- BUY-side mutex lock
